verdict.rationale: The DPMA's own pages document electronic filing as an alternative to paper. DPMAdirektWeb handles trade mark and design applications without a signature card, and DPMAdirektPro handles IP applications, including patents, with a signature card and free downloadable software. That means the core transaction, filing an application, can be completed online. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a completed online filing, evidence of online fee payment, and patent filing without a signature card or desktop software (DPMAdirektWeb is also German-only).

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: the DPMA also offers the option to file applications electronically
DPMAdirektWeb Filing trade marks and designs online without signature card
DPMAdirektPro Filing IP applications online with signature card
you need the DPMAdirektPro application software in order to create and validate the application documents
